We capture the moments that tell the event

Event & Conference Coverage

Planned coverage for conferences, launches and events, with photography, highlight films and rapid social content when required.

A focused solution built around the result

We map the agenda, people and must-capture moments before the crew arrives, then work discreetly around the attendee experience.

What this service solves

  • Complete coverage of key moments
  • Fast assets for press and social use
  • A highlight film that carries the event forward

What you receive

  • Coverage plan and crew movement
  • Video and photography by scope
  • Optional interviews and statements
  • Highlight film
  • Fast social-ready cuts

How the work moves

  1. Review the event program
  2. Define crew and equipment
  3. Capture on location
  4. Select and edit
  5. Deliver fast-turnaround and final assets

A strong fit for

  • Conferences and exhibitions
  • Openings and product launches
  • Corporate events
  • Celebrations and community programs

Frequently asked questions

Do you provide both photo and video?

The crew can be scoped for either or both.
